data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of $5.582 million in prior year claims reserves, representing a 2.42% deterioration of opening reserves. This was primarily driven by the impact of significant catastrophe events in 2017 (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, and two Mexican earthquakes) on the 2016 year of account, as well as higher than expected 2016 calendar year loss experience including Hurricane Matthew and other flood and hail losses. These events particularly affected Property Direct & Facultative and Property Binding Authority classes.
